Hi MultipleChat team,

I saw your call for a Professional Content Creator to make engaging, educational content about AI tools and productivity, and I wanted to write because that is exactly the kind of work I already do. I build my own AI products — a dog-care app on Google Play, a fitness tracker, a calorie tracker and an AI job-search assistant — so I explain how these tools work from first-hand use, not from a brief. I also write SEO-optimised content daily: I built a ~600-page site for a pharmacists' association, ranked #3 on Google for "Belgian chess prodigy" and #4 for "PDKS", and I run Google Ads with a 4.57% CTR. I use Claude and ChatGPT in my workflow and Canva for visuals. I live near Antwerp with my own car, so working with your team is easy. I would love to talk about how I can turn complex AI topics into clear, useful content for your audience.

Best regards,
Baver Ok
+32 470 42 48 36
baverok@gmail.com
baverok.com | linkedin.com/in/baverok
cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Manager,

I am writing to apply for the Professional Content Creator role at MultipleChat. Your focus on making AI tools, productivity and digital workflows understandable and engaging is exactly the kind of content I create every day. I build my own AI products — PupSmart, a dog-care app on Google Play with a potty predictor and toxic-food scanner; Rebound, a fitness tracker that syncs with a smartwatch and smart scale; Tabağım, a calorie tracker; and an AI job-search assistant — so when I write about AI, I write from hands-on experience, not from a press release.

At Episto I run keyword research, technical SEO and content for client businesses. I built and launched around 600 member profile pages for a pharmacists' association on one consistent layout, and I helped a client reach #4 on page 1 of Google Turkey for "PDKS". As a freelancer I earned a 4.57% CTR and 53 clicks from a self-funded Google Ads test for a kids' bike brand, writing the landing pages and choosing buyer-intent keywords myself. Earlier, at Knowledge Experts, I ranked a personal-brand site #3 on Google for "Belgian chess prodigy" and built kxp.be single-handedly in English, Dutch and French. I use Claude and ChatGPT daily and Canva for visuals, and I am comfortable creating scripts for short videos and reels.

I work in English every day and I write and speak Dutch at a working level. I live near Antwerp with my own car, so travelling to your team is no problem.

In the first weeks I would map the questions your audience asks about AI and productivity, then turn them into a content calendar of SEO articles, social posts and short-video scripts, each with a clear takeaway. I would like to talk about how I can help MultipleChat own that conversation.

## SUMMARY
I create clear, engaging content about AI tools and digital workflows, drawing on hands-on experience with SEO, Google Ads and WordPress. At Episto I write SEO-optimized articles and website content for clients, and as a freelancer I sell AI search visibility and marketing automation services. I build my own AI products, like a dog-care app on Google Play and a job-search assistant, so I understand how to simplify complex tech topics for real users. I also have a background in front-end development and tango instruction, which taught me to explain things simply and work with people. I speak Dutch at B1/A2+ and I am eager to learn.

## PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

### Junior Digital Marketer – Episto (Remote), 03/2026 – Present

- Support a WooCommerce webshop ([proteinbox.com.tr](https://proteinbox.com.tr)) with catalogue, product content and conversion pages
- Track KPIs (rankings, traffic, CTR) in Semrush, Ahrefs, GA4 and Search Console and report on results
- **#4 on page 1** of Google Turkey for "PDKS" (access-control software), as part of the agency team

### Freelance Digital Marketer – [baverok.com](https://baverok.com), 09/2026 – Present

- Brought in a construction company through a referral, led the discovery meeting and built a full growth proposal covering the website, Google Business Profile, regional Google Ads and social media

### Web & SEO Specialist – Knowledge Experts ([KXP](https://kxp.be)), 01/2024 – 02/2026

## PROJECTS & PRODUCTS

### PupSmart – AI dog-care app on [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.momoco.pupsmart)
- Designed, built and launched an Android app with a potty predictor, a toxic-food scanner and AI health insights based on each dog's 7-day activity log
- Published it under my own label, MomoCo: free with ads, with premium AI features for subscribers

### AI job-search assistant

### Rebound – personal fitness app
- Built a fitness app that logs every workout and syncs data from a smartwatch and smart scale, turning steps, calories and body stats into clear progress graphs
- Developed and deployed it solo with AI coding tools (Claude Code), shipping features as soon as needed

- **SEO & marketing:** content marketing, SEO strategy, keyword research, on-page, technical, local and mobile SEO, link building, SEO audits, schema markup, AI search (GEO/AEO), Google Ads Search, WooCommerce
- **Growth & sales:** landing pages, lead generation, client discovery meetings, offers and proposals, A/B testing
- **Data & tools:** Canva, Claude/ChatGPT, WordPress/Elementor, GA4, Google Search Console, Semrush, Ahrefs, Microsoft Clarity, HTML/CSS, Odoo
